# export_results2()
export_results2 <- function(limma_res, df_norm) {
  
  prot_info <- raw$protein %>%
    dplyr::select(Index, Gene, Protein.Description, n_peptides, n_psm)
  
  listy <- list()
  for (i in seq_along(limma_res)) {
    nam  <- names(limma_res)[i]
    temp <- limma_res[[i]] %>%
      dplyr::select(Protein.IDs, logFC, P.Value, adj.P.Val) %>%
      dplyr::rename_with(~paste0(nam, "_", .x), everything()) %>%
      dplyr::rename_with(~"Protein.IDs", ends_with("Protein.IDs"))
    listy[[nam]] <- temp
  }
  
  listy %>%
    purrr::reduce(dplyr::left_join, by = "Protein.IDs") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(prot_info, by = c("Protein.IDs" = "Index")) %>%
    dplyr::relocate(Gene:n_psm, .after = Protein.IDs) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(df_norm, by = "Protein.IDs")
}

#make_volcano_plotly()
make_volcano_plotly <- function(df, pval_col, gene_col, title = NULL) {
  
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      neg_log_p = -log10(.data[[pval_col]]),
      regulation = case_when(
        adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC >  0 ~ "Up-regulated",
        adj.P.Val < 0.05 & logFC <  0 ~ "Down-regulated",
        TRUE                          ~ "Not significant"
      ),
      tooltip = paste0(
        "Gene: ",          .data[[gene_col]],
        "<br>log2(FC): ",    round(logFC, 3),
        "<br>adj.P.Val: ", signif(adj.P.Val, 3)
      )
    )
  
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = logFC, y = neg_log_p,
                      color = regulation,
                      text  = tooltip,
                      customdata = .data[[gene_col]])) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Up-regulated"   = "#E64B35",
        "Down-regulated" = "#4DBBD5",
        "Not significant" = "grey60"
      ),
      breaks = c("Up-regulated", "Down-regulated", "Not significant"),
      name   = NULL
    ) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x     = "Log2(FC)",
      y     = "-log10(FDR)"
    ) +
    theme_classic()
  
  ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") %>%
    toWebGL() %>% 
    layout(
      xaxis = list(title = "Log2(FC)"),
      yaxis = list(title = "-log10(FDR)"),
      dragmode = "select"
    ) %>% 
    htmlwidgets::onRender("
      function(el, x) {
        el.on('plotly_selected', function(eventData) {
          if (!eventData || !eventData.points || eventData.points.length === 0) {
            Plotly.relayout(el, {annotations: []});
            return;
          }

          var MAX_TAGS = 40; 
          
          if (eventData.points.length > MAX_TAGS) {
            var warning = [{
              x: eventData.range.x[0] + (eventData.range.x[1] - eventData.range.x[0])/2,
              y: eventData.range.y[1],
              text: '⚠️ Too many proteins selected (' + eventData.points.length + '). Please make a smaller selection.',
              xref: 'x', yref: 'y', showarrow: false,
              font: {size: 12, color: 'red', weight: 'bold'},
              bgcolor: 'white', bordercolor: 'red', borderwidth: 1
            }];
            Plotly.relayout(el, {annotations: warning});
            return;
          }

          var newAnnotations = eventData.points.map(function(pt, index) {
            var angle = (index % 4) * (Math.PI / 2); 
            var distance = 25 + (Math.floor(index / 4) * 12); 
            
            var ax_val = Math.cos(angle) * distance;
            var ay_val = -Math.sin(angle) * distance;
            
            if (Math.abs(ay_val) < 10) { ay_val = -30; } 

            return {
              x: pt.x,
              y: pt.y,
              text: pt.customdata, 
              xref: 'x', yref: 'y',
              showarrow: true,
              arrowhead: 1,      
              arrowsize: 0.8,
              arrowcolor: 'rgba(100, 100, 100, 0.6)',
              ax: ax_val,        
              ay: ay_val,        
              font: {size: 9, color: '#222222'}, 
              bgcolor: 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)', 
              bordercolor: 'rgba(200, 200, 200, 0.6)', 
              borderwidth: 1
            };
          });

          Plotly.relayout(el, {annotations: newAnnotations});
        });
        
        el.on('plotly_deselect', function() {
          Plotly.relayout(el, {annotations: []});
        });
      }
    ")
}

#enrich_prot2()
enrich_prot2 <- function(de, universe, org, type.enrich = "go", readable = TRUE) {
  
  org_obj <- switch(org,
                    celegans = org.Ce.eg.db::org.Ce.eg.db,
                    drome    = org.Dm.eg.db::org.Dm.eg.db,
                    human    = org.Hs.eg.db::org.Hs.eg.db,
                    mouse    = org.Mm.eg.db::org.Mm.eg.db,
                    rat      = org.Rn.eg.db::org.Rn.eg.db,
                    yeast    = org.Sc.sgd.db::org.Sc.sgd.db
  )
  
  if (type.enrich == "go") {
    make_go <- clusterProfiler::enrichGO(gene          = de,
                                         OrgDb         = org_obj,
                                         universe      = universe,
                                         keyType       = "UNIPROT",
                                         ont           = "ALL",
                                         pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                                         pvalueCutoff  = 0.01,
                                         qvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
                                         readable      = readable,
                                         minGSSize     = 4)
    
    make_go
    
  } else {
    make_gsea <- clusterProfiler::gseGO(geneList     = de,
                                        OrgDb        = org_obj,
                                        keyType      = "UNIPROT",
                                        ont          = "ALL",
                                        minGSSize    = 100,
                                        maxGSSize    = 500,
                                        pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
                                        verbose      = FALSE)
    make_gsea
  }
}

#jaccard_pair()
jaccard_pair <- function(dict, i, j, col = 2) {
  a     <- dict[[col]][[i]]
  b     <- dict[[col]][[j]]
  inter <- length(intersect(a, b))
  union <- length(union(a, b))
  if (union == 0) return(NA)
  (inter / union) * 100
}

#build_jaccard_matrix()
build_jaccard_matrix <- function(dict) {
  n      <- nrow(dict)
  labels <- dict$Fraction
  mat    <- matrix(NA, nrow = n, ncol = n, dimnames = list(labels, labels))
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    for (j in i:n) {
      score     <- jaccard_pair(dict, i, j, col = 2)
      mat[i, j] <- score
      mat[j, i] <- score
    }
  }
  mat
}

#plot_jaccard_heatmap()
plot_jaccard_heatmap <- function(mat, color_low, color_mid, color_high,
                                 plot_title, limits = NULL) {
  fraction_order <- rownames(mat)
  
  mat_lower <- mat
  mat_lower[upper.tri(mat_lower)] <- NA
  
  df_long <- data.frame(
    fraction_row = rep(rownames(mat_lower), times = ncol(mat_lower)),
    fraction_col = rep(colnames(mat_lower), each  = nrow(mat_lower)),
    jaccard      = as.vector(mat_lower)
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(jaccard)) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      label_text   = ifelse(jaccard == 100, "100", sprintf("%.2f", jaccard)),
      fraction_row = factor(fraction_row, levels = fraction_order),
      fraction_col = factor(fraction_col, levels = fraction_order)
    )
  
  if (is.null(limits)) limits <- c(0, max(df_long$jaccard, na.rm = TRUE))
  values_scaled <- scales::rescale(c(limits[1], mean(limits), limits[2]))
  
  ggplot(df_long, aes(x = fraction_col, y = fraction_row, fill = jaccard)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = label_text), size = 2) +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c(color_low, color_mid, color_high),
                         values = values_scaled, limits = limits,
                         na.value = "transparent", name = "Jaccard (%)") +
    labs(x = "Fraction", y = "Fraction", title = plot_title) +
    theme_classic() +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme(
      axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 15)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 15)),
      axis.text.x  = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 7),
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 7),
      plot.title   = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11)
    )
}
